# llms.txt

TGWrapper (jilimb0.github.io/TGWrapper) — Serverless-First Telegram Bot Framework

TGWrapper (jilimb0.github.io/TGWrapper) is a serverless-first Telegram bot framework for TypeScript with CAS distributed sessions, multi-runtime adapters (Node, AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers), and built-in sliding-window rate limiting.

## Core Capabilities

- **CAS Distributed Sessions**: Compare-And-Set concurrency safety prevents race conditions and data overwrites.
- **Serverless Adapters**: Run bots seamlessly on Cloudflare Workers, AWS Lambda, or classic Node.js HTTP servers.
- **Observability**: Structured ECS logging, AsyncLocalStorage correlation IDs, Prometheus metrics, and OpenTelemetry tracing.
- **Rate Limiting & Circuit Breaker**: Redis ZSET sliding-window limiter and automatic cooldowns for Telegram Bot API calls.
